title: license file
description: A license file on disk, as nw-license writes it and mankit's licenses package reads it: the payload's bytes exactly as signed and the Ed25519 signature over them, so an app checks the file offline against the keys its build trusts (ADR-L1, L5, L6). Stored at the org's or the app's place (ADR-L8). A file that is not this shape is refused as unreadable.

payload.description: The signed bytes, standard base64: JSON that meets license-payload.schema.json. Kept as bytes, not as an object, so the signature is checked over exactly what was signed.

signature.description: The Ed25519 signature over the payload's bytes, standard base64: 64 bytes, so 88 characters ending ==, made with the key the payload's keyId names (ADR-L1, L6).
